source: Task Decomposition instructions supplied with UPD-S1-2026-11-07-001
purpose: Shared, mandatory saturation and closure rules for every Step One output version.

classification.material: Classify by practical effect. A small correction to a required omission, missing task, or incorrect acceptance criterion is material. A material change resets minor_edit_streak to 0.
classification.minor: Wording-only or cosmetic polish is minor. A minor change increments minor_edit_streak.
classification.none: No substantive task-list change. A no-change closure-check version does not count as a minor edit.
classification.history: Before every version, inspect the complete registered history in root.json. Do not infer history from filenames or commit order alone.

saturation.trigger: Three consecutive registered minor versions trigger closure_signal=approaching_closure.
saturation.next_agent: The agent creating the third consecutive minor version must explicitly instruct the next agent to prioritize closure.
saturation.persistence: Once triggered, closure_signal remains active until the stage is completed.
saturation.after_trigger: Do not add optional detail or make cosmetic edits merely to demonstrate activity. Record nonessential ideas as optional follow-ups only when useful.
saturation.defect_override: Do not ignore a real defect, missing required task, or unresolved blocking issue. A necessary material correction is permitted; set content_changed=true, reset consecutive_no_change_closure_checks to 0, and keep closure mode active.

requirements: The agent reviews the latest registered version and complete root.json history.
No material or otherwise necessary content change is needed.
Save a complete, self-contained version with change_classification=none and content_changed=false.
Register this check in root.json closure.closure_checks with version, agent label, result and content_changed=false.
The immediately following registered version reviews the first check and the complete root.json history.
The agent label must be different from the first closure-check agent.
The substantive task list still needs no change and no blocking issue remains.
Save a complete version with change_classification=none and content_changed=false.
Set closure_result=confirm_close and parent_version to the first closure-check version.
Register this check in root.json closure.closure_checks.

closure.reset: Any substantive task-list change or blocking issue resets consecutive_no_change_closure_checks to 0. Closure checks must be consecutive registered versions and use distinct agent labels.
closure.completion: Only after the second valid check has been registered successfully may root.json set status=completed and final_version to the second check's version. One agent's opinion, a minor-edit threshold, or newest filename is not enough.
closure.failure: Never claim closure or completion if root.json update failed. Preserve every previous version.

root_authority.source: root.json is the authoritative state for the registered version, history, counters, closure checks, stage status and final_version.
root_authority.conflict: If root counters/history conflict with registered versions, stop and report the inconsistency. Do not guess or silently repair.
root_authority.registration: A version is registered only after its complete file exists and root.json is successfully updated to reference it.
